stem: Which of these is an important idea expressed in the excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: People must start working toward their goals at a young age to achieve their dreams.

options.label: B
options.text: Honesty and openness allow deep friendships to develop.

options.label: C
options.text: True understanding can take place only through quiet reflection.

options.label: D
options.text: Some people influence the lives of others by introducing them to new ideas.
